title: Junie — Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: IDE · CLI · Headless CI/CD · GitHub · GitLab

rows.label: What it is
rows.value: Coding agent — delegate work to be executed, not just discussed

rows.label: Surfaces
rows.value: JetBrains IDEs · CLI (terminal) · headless CI/CD

rows.label: Install (Linux/macOS)
rows.value: curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash

rows.label: Install (Windows)
rows.value: iex (irm 'https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.ps1') via PowerShell

rows.label: Install (npm)
rows.value: npm install -g @jetbrains/junie

rows.label: Install (Homebrew)
rows.value: brew install jetbrains/junie/junie

rows.label: Launch
rows.value: Run junie from your project root

rows.label: Auth options
rows.value: JetBrains Account · JUNIE_API_KEY · BYOK · custom endpoints

rows.label: First prompt
rows.value: Type prompt; use @ to attach files, / for slash commands

rows.label: Plan Mode
rows.value: Read-only design-first pass before any edits; /plan or Shift+Tab

rows.label: Debug Mode
rows.value: Live debugger assistant via connected JetBrains IDE; /debug

rows.label: Hooks (EAP)
rows.value: Shell commands on session lifecycle events via ~/.junie/config.json hooks

rows.label: Demo Agent (EAP)
rows.value: Visual VM-based demo of running app; /demo (requires Docker)

rows.label: Git Worktrees
rows.value: Parallel sessions with isolated checkouts; /worktree

rows.label: Remote Mode
rows.value: Continue CLI session from a browser on another device; /remote

rows.label: Brave Mode
rows.value: Three-level approval control (Off / Auto / On); /brave or Ctrl+B

rows.label: Model & Effort
rows.value: Per-session model + reasoning effort selection; /model, /effort

rows.label: ACP support
rows.value: Agent Client Protocol mode for editor integrations; junie --acp true

rows.label: Agent loop
rows.value: Prompt → plan → multi-file edits → commands → verification → summary

rows.label: Good task scope
rows.value: Bounded, testable, with explicit acceptance criteria stated in the prompt

rows.label: @-attach context
rows.value: Type @ to attach the smallest useful file or folder to the request

rows.label: Image inputs
rows.value: Drag-and-drop or @-reference screenshots/design specs (PNG, JPEG)

rows.label: Follow-up prompts
rows.value: Type clarifications while Junie works; they are appended immediately

rows.label: Roll back changes
rows.value: IDE: use Done panel to revert per-file; CLI: undo via git or discard edits

rows.label: Shell passthrough
rows.value: Prefix with ! to run a shell command without leaving Junie CLI

rows.label: Primary file
rows.value: .junie/AGENTS.md — loaded exclusively when present

rows.label: Fallback chain
rows.value: Root AGENTS.md combined with .junie/playbook.md & .junie/rules/*.md

rows.label: Legacy (deprecated)
rows.value: .junie/guidelines.md or .junie/guidelines/ directory

rows.label: Custom path (IDE)
rows.value: Override in Settings → Tools → Junie → Project Settings

rows.label: CLI override
rows.value: guidelines-location field in config.json or --guidelines-location

rows.label: Version control
rows.value: Commit .junie/AGENTS.md to share team-wide coding standards

rows.label: Project trust
rows.value: Interactive sessions prompt for trust before loading project-scoped config

rows.label: Config file
rows.value: .junie/config.json (project) or ~/.junie/config.json (user)

rows.label: Multi-file edits
rows.value: Creates, reads, and modifies files across the project automatically

rows.label: Runs commands
rows.value: Executes shell commands; sensitive ones need approval unless allowlisted

rows.label: Verification
rows.value: Runs tests, builds, inspections to confirm changes are correct

rows.label: IDE-backed features
rows.value: Symbol search, code inspections, test discovery when JetBrains IDE connected

rows.label: Subagents
rows.value: Delegates sub-tasks automatically; custom subagents in .junie/agents/

rows.label: Agent Skills
rows.value: Reusable skill bundles; discoverable via skill-locations in config.json

rows.label: Extensions
rows.value: Bundle skills + MCP + commands; browse & install via /extensions

rows.label: .aiignore
rows.value: Create .aiignore to require approval before reading/editing sensitive files

rows.label: Verify install
rows.value: junie --version

rows.label: Slash menu
rows.value: Type / in prompt to see all available slash commands

rows.label: Shortcuts help
rows.value: Type ? to list all keyboard shortcuts

rows.label: Prompt history
rows.value: Ctrl+R to search prompt history; navigate with arrow keys

rows.label: Transcript view
rows.value: Ctrl+O opens continuously updated transcript.md

rows.label: Quit (keep creds)
rows.value: /quit exits without clearing login credentials

rows.label: All options
rows.value: junie --help lists all CLI flags and environment variables

rows.label: Toggle
rows.value: Shift+Tab cycles: default → Plan → Debug

rows.label: Slash command
rows.value: /plan or /plan <prompt> to enable and immediately submit

rows.label: CLI flag
rows.value: junie --plan or junie --prompt "…" --plan

rows.label: Plan view
rows.value: Ctrl+P opens full plan (Requirements, Design, Testing, Delivery tabs)

rows.label: Iterate
rows.value: Push back on assumptions in follow-ups before confirming; each costs nothing

rows.label: Confirm & implement
rows.value: Select Confirm and implement to let Junie proceed with the agreed plan

rows.label: Save without impl
rows.value: Select Save the plan and stop to write plan file to disk and exit

rows.label: Re-enable
rows.value: Plan mode resets after each prompt; press Shift+Tab again to keep planning

rows.label: IDE entry point
rows.value: AI Chat tool window → select Junie by JetBrains from the agents list

rows.label: Min IDE version
rows.value: 2024.3.2+ (IntelliJ Ultimate, PyCharm Pro, WebStorm, GoLand); 2025.1+ others

rows.label: Supported IDEs
rows.value: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, RubyMine, Rider, CLion, RustRover, Android Studio

rows.label: Code mode
rows.value: Full agentic: edits files, runs commands, verifies changes

rows.label: Ask mode
rows.value: Read-only: explore, analyze, brainstorm — no file edits

rows.label: /ide command
rows.value: /ide shows IDE connection state and allows switching IDE sessions

rows.label: /debug command
rows.value: /debug activates live debugger assistant (requires IDE debug session)

rows.label: MCP (IDE)
rows.value: Add servers via Settings → Tools → Junie → MCP Settings; max 100 tools

rows.label: /review
rows.value: Opens wizard: From Main · Last Commit · Unstaged Changes

rows.label: Custom scope
rows.value: /review focusing on performance and memory leaks — natural language

rows.label: [CRITICAL]
rows.value: Security, crash, data-loss, or correctness findings are prefixed [CRITICAL]

rows.label: Code suggestions
rows.value: Ready-to-apply fix included when the change is simple and safe

rows.label: Accept/dismiss
rows.value: Browse by file; accept or dismiss suggestions individually or in bulk

rows.label: Headless review
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" --review with optional instructions

rows.label: Git required
rows.value: /review requires a .git directory; reports error if none found

rows.label: Human in loop
rows.value: Keep humans in the PR/MR approval path; don't auto-merge AI-only changes

rows.label: /model
rows.value: Pick LLM + reasoning effort for the current session interactively

rows.label: /effort
rows.value: Change only the effort level (minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max)

rows.label: /usage
rows.value: Shows token cost breakdown, models used, and remaining balance

rows.label: JUNIE_API_KEY
rows.value: Usage-based billing token; generate at junie.jetbrains.com/cli

rows.label: BYOK providers
rows.value: OpenAI · Anthropic · Google · xAI · OpenRouter · GitHub Copilot · LiteLLM

rows.label: Model aliases
rows.value: sonnet, opus, gpt, gemini-pro, gemini-flash, grok, gpt-codex

rows.label: Default model
rows.value: Default = dynamically chosen best price-quality ratio model

rows.label: Effort caution
rows.value: Higher effort costs significantly more; increase only when measurably beneficial

rows.label: /mcp
rows.value: Lists configured servers; opens MCP Installation Assistant (Ctrl+A)

rows.label: Project config
rows.value: .junie/mcp/mcp.json — commit to share MCP setup with team

rows.label: User config
rows.value: ~/.junie/mcp/mcp.json — private, available across all projects

rows.label: Add from registry
rows.value: Ctrl+A in /mcp screen searches official MCP registry for configs

rows.label: OAuth servers
rows.value: Status shows Authorization required; use Installation Assistant to authorize

rows.label: Tool limit
rows.value: Maximum 100 tools from all configured MCP servers

rows.label: Extensions
rows.value: Install MCP servers bundled in extensions via /extensions marketplace

rows.label: Disable server
rows.value: Select server in /mcp list → Disable; re-enable with → Enable

rows.label: Basic run
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" "Fix any failing tests"

rows.label: --review flag
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" --review runs code review headlessly

rows.label: --plan flag
rows.value: junie --plan starts in plan mode; combine with --prompt

rows.label: Non-interactive trust
rows.value: Headless runs are auto-trusted; only run in repos you control

rows.label: Extra config files
rows.value: --config-location /path/to/config.json (repeatable)

rows.label: Disable defaults
rows.value: --config-default-locations false ignores user & project config.json

rows.label: Env var auth
rows.value: JUNIE_API_KEY env var equivalent to --auth flag

rows.label: All options
rows.value: See full flag & env-var reference at junie --help or docs parameters.html

rows.label: Action ref
rows.value: JetBrains/junie-github-action@v1 in .github/workflows/

rows.label: Trigger phrase
rows.value: Comment @junie-agent in an issue or PR to invoke the agent

rows.label: Required secret
rows.value: JUNIE_API_KEY in Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions

rows.label: BYOK keys
rows.value: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, etc.

rows.label: Permissions
rows.value: Needs contents: write, pull-requests: write, issues: write

rows.label: Auto review
rows.value: Use cookbook template + pull_request events for automated PR reviews

rows.label: MCP in Actions
rows.value: allowed_mcp_servers: "mcp_github_checks_server" input parameter

rows.label: Output: pr_url
rows.value: steps.junie.outputs.pr_url gives URL of any created pull request

rows.label: Trigger
rows.value: Comment #junie in a GitLab issue or MR to invoke the agent

rows.label: Setup token
rows.value: GITLAB_TOKEN_FOR_JUNIE — Maintainer-role PAT with api scope

rows.label: Junie API key
rows.value: JUNIE_API_KEY CI/CD variable (or BYOK equivalent)

rows.label: Container project
rows.value: Create a separate empty GitLab project to host Junie's CI pipelines

rows.label: Initialize
rows.value: Run the init pipeline with PROJECTS_TO_INIT = comma-separated project IDs

rows.label: MR review trigger
rows.value: Include code-review keyword in a #junie comment on an MR

rows.label: Auto review
rows.value: Disable by unchecking Merge request events in Junie webhook settings

rows.label: Iterate on MR
rows.value: Comment #junie on Junie's MR to request follow-up changes

rows.label: /new
rows.value: /new starts another live session; current session stays in background

rows.label: /new with prompt
rows.value: /new update tests for payment flow pre-fills the new session

rows.label: /history
rows.value: Opens Task history; search, switch live sessions, or resume saved ones

rows.label: History scope
rows.value: Press Tab in /history to toggle between all dirs and current project

rows.label: /worktree
rows.value: Create or switch to a Git worktree for isolated parallel file changes

rows.label: Worktree naming
rows.value: Auto-named <project>-junie-wt-01, created as sibling of project dir

rows.label: /remote
rows.value: Share CLI session with web UI at junie.jetbrains.com/remote

rows.label: Transcript
rows.value: Ctrl+O opens transcript.md; subagent transcripts in subagents/

rows.label: Approval model
rows.value: Sensitive actions (shell, file edits outside project, MCP) require explicit approval

rows.label: Action Allowlist
rows.value: Select Always allow at prompt; stored in ~/.junie/allowlist.json

rows.label: Brave mode levels
rows.value: Off = always ask · Auto = classify & auto-allow safe · On = no prompts

rows.label: Hooks safety
rows.value: Project .junie/config.json hooks ignored by default; use user config or --config-location

rows.label: BYOK privacy
rows.value: BYOK routes requests directly to the provider; no JetBrains intermediary

rows.label: Untrusted project
rows.value: Untrusted project skips MCP, hooks, agents, skills, guidelines, and memory

rows.label: Trust storage
rows.value: Trust keys stored in OS keychain; markers under ~/.junie/trust/

rows.label: Revoke trust
rows.value: Delete marker under ~/.junie/trust/ to revoke on next launch

rows.label: Config location
rows.value: Add hooks object to ~/.junie/config.json or --config-location file

rows.label: SessionStart
rows.value: Fires on startup, resume, clear, compact — use for credential refresh

rows.label: UserPromptSubmit
rows.value: Fires before each prompt is sent; can add context or block the prompt

rows.label: PreToolUse
rows.value: Fires before each tool call; can allow, ask, or block via JSON output

rows.label: Stop hook
rows.value: Gates task completion; exit code 2 or {"decision":"block"} forces retry

rows.label: PermissionRequest
rows.value: Auto-allow or auto-deny approval dialogs by tool name (Bash, Edit, etc.)

rows.label: StopFailure
rows.value: Observability-only; fires on LLM/API errors (rate_limit, server_error, etc.)

rows.label: Async hooks
rows.value: Set "async": true to run in background without blocking the agent

rows.label: Start bounded
rows.value: Small, testable tasks with clear exit criteria complete faster and more reliably

rows.label: Plan complex work
rows.value: Use Plan mode for any task spanning multiple modules or introducing new APIs

rows.label: Explicit validation
rows.value: State required test/lint commands and expected outcomes in the prompt

rows.label: Smallest context
rows.value: Attach only the files directly relevant; large context slows and dilutes reasoning

rows.label: Prefer allowlist
rows.value: Add recurring safe commands to the Action Allowlist rather than enabling Brave mode

rows.label: Parallel worktrees
rows.value: Pre-create worktrees so build caches are warm before starting parallel tasks

rows.label: Version-pin actions
rows.value: Use @v1.x.x tags in GitHub Action for reproducible CI runs

rows.label: Review before merge
rows.value: Always keep a human in the PR/MR approval path for production changes
